reference/CodeSmile.LunyInput.ActionKind.summary: Enum ActionKind Namespace CodeSmile.LunyInput Assembly ApiSource.dll What a player action produces, which decides how its value is read and which actions of the action asset may be found as it. public enum ActionKind Expand Details ... Fields Button = 0 A pressed state and an analogue press from 0 to 1; found for an action of type Button or whose expected control type is Button. Number = 1 One number, 0 at rest; found for an action whose expected control type is Axis or Analog, or a value action that names no control type. Vector2 = 2 Two components; found for an action whose expected control type is Vector2, Stick or Dpad. Vector3 = 3 Three components; found for an action whose expected control type is Vector3. Examples var lookup = input.Player(0).TryFind("Fire", ActionKind.Button, out var fire);

Fields Found = 0 The action was found and produces the asked kind. A view that allocates nothing, so reading it every frame is free. public readonly struct InputPlayer Expand Details ... Examples var player = input.Player(1); var move = player.Vector2("Move"); if (player.IsPresent) transform.position += (Vector3)move.Value * Time.deltaTime; Remarks Find each action once, in Awake or Start, and keep the handle: a find compares the name with every action of the asset, and a handle's reads ask no device. Finding the same action again returns the same handle. With players a LocalInput pairs, every index has its actions from the start, so a handle found before anybody paired starts reading the moment somebody does. Properties HoldsPointer Whether this player holds the mouse. The keyboard and the mouse pair together and belong to one player at a time. public bool HoldsPointer { get; } Property Value bool Examples var aimWithPointer = player.HoldsPointer; Identity The identity of the person on this index, or 0 for nobody. public long Identity { get; } Property Value long Examples if (player.Identity != m_LastIdentity) Respawn(); Remarks It changes when a different person takes the index, and stays the same when the same person's device is lost and regained. No two people get the same identity from one LocalInput. It is the InputUser id with players a LocalInput pairs or PlayerInput components, and 1 for player 0 of the one-player setup. Index Which player this is, from 0. The host of the setup that pairs players is player 0. public int Index { get; } Property Value int Examples var index = player.Index; IsLost Whether the device this player is paired with has disconnected. False for nobody. public bool IsLost { get; } Property Value bool Examples m_PausedForLostPad = player.IsLost; Remarks The player keeps the index and the Identity while the device is lost. Returns bool False when this player has no actions; nothing changes then. Returns ButtonAction The handle; the same handle every time the same action is found. Examples var fire = input.Player(0).Button("Fire"); Exceptions LunyInputException The player has no actions, has no action of that name, or the action produces another kind of value. Returns bool True for the same index of the same LocalInput. Returns bool true if obj and this instance are the same type and represent the same value; otherwise, false. Examples if (leave.PerformedThisFrame) input.Player(2).Leave(); Number(string) This player's one-number action of that name, such as a trigger or a throttle axis. public NumberAction Number(string actionName) Parameters Type Name Description string actionName The action's name as the asset spells it, or map/action. Examples var throttle = input.Player(0).Number("Throttle"); Exceptions LunyInputException The player has no actions, has no action of that name, or the action produces another kind of value. reference/CodeSmile.LunyInput.LocalInput.title: Class LocalInput | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunyInput.LocalInput.summary: Class LocalInput Namespace CodeSmile.LunyInput Assembly ApiSource.dll The input of the players on one machine, read from an Input System action asset: each player's actions as typed handles, the phases each action received in the frame that is running, the pairing of devices to players, interactive rebinding, and the binding overrides a game stores. public sealed class LocalInput Expand Details ... Inheritance object LocalInput Examples var input = new LocalInput(actions, 4); var fire = input.Player(0).Button("Fire"); if (fire.PerformedThisFrame) Shoot(); input.Dispose(); Remarks The action asset owns the bindings and the processors. Nothing here creates an action, binds a key or applies a processor: it finds the action a caller names, checks it produces the kind the caller asked for, and reads it. A read returns the last value the action received. Each action's value and pressed state are recorded while the Input System processes input: in the action's own started, performed and canceled callbacks and at the end of every input update, through InputSystem.onAfterUpdate. A read returns that record and asks no device, so FixedUpdate and Update read the same value whether the Input System processes input before each frame, before each fixed step or when the game calls InputSystem.Update. An action that received nothing reads its resting value. Three setups, chosen by the constructor. new LocalInput(actions) is one player, player 0, present from the start on every device; pairing is refused. new LocalInput(actions, 4) pairs up to four players itself: each gets its own copy of the action asset and an InputUser. The first button press makes the host, player 0, who reads every device until pairing first opens; after that each press on a device nobody holds pairs it while pairing is open, and the guests are players 1, 2 and 3. new LocalInput() reads the players of the scene's PlayerInput components, which PlayerInputManager pairs. Disposal. Dispose() releases the action copies, the InputUsers and every Input System subscription. A LocalInput still alive when the application quits, which in the Editor is when Play Mode ends, disposes itself then, so a forgotten one holds no device and records nothing in the next Play Mode session. Assets/CodeSmile/LunyInput/README.md is the contract, and LunyScript's InputSystemProvider reads its players through this type. Constructors LocalInput() Creates a LocalInput that reads whichever PlayerInput components are present, and nothing else. public LocalInput() Examples var input = new LocalInput(); Remarks Use this when the scene pairs its players with PlayerInputManager. Player n is the PlayerInput whose player index is n; a player index with no PlayerInput has no actions. LocalInput(InputActionAsset) Creates a LocalInput for one player, player 0, present from the start and reading every device through actions. public LocalInput(InputActionAsset actions) Parameters Type Name Description InputActionAsset actions The action asset of player 0, or null for none. Examples var input = new LocalInput(actions); Remarks A PlayerInput for a player index always wins, because that is where the Input System keeps that player's paired devices; the asset is what a single-player game uses, where there is nothing to pair. The asset is enabled here, because an action that is not enabled reads its resting value forever, which reads exactly like a wrong binding. A PlayerInput's own actions are left alone: that component enables and disables them itself. LocalInput(InputActionAsset, int) Creates a LocalInput that pairs up to players players itself. Nobody is present until someone presses a button. public LocalInput(InputActionAsset actions, int players) Parameters Type Name Description InputActionAsset actions The action asset each player's copy is made from. int players How many players can pair, the host included, from 1. Examples var input = new LocalInput(actions, 4); Remarks The first player to pair is the host, player 0, who stays for as long as this LocalInput lives. Every later player is a guest on the lowest free index from 1 up. The solo start. Until pairing first opens, the first button press on a device the asset can use makes the host, and the host's actions read every device, so a game for one player needs no pairing code. OpenPairing() for the first time ends it: the host keeps their InputUser and Identity, their actions read no device, and the next device pressed becomes the host's, with pairing open or not. A guest pairs only while pairing is open. The press that pairs a device is not delivered to the actions of the player it pairs. Each player gets its own copy of actions, made here with Object.Instantiate, so the actions of two players are different InputAction objects and one gamepad cannot drive both. A copy is restricted to the devices paired with its player and is disabled while nobody holds the index. PlayerInput components are not read by this setup. A pairing request, a press on a device nobody holds or a Leave(), is applied at the end of the input update that received it, or of the next one for a leave. Exceptions LunyInputException actions is null or players is below 1. Properties Capacity How many player indices this LocalInput holds, from 0. Allocates nothing. public int Capacity { get; } Property Value int Examples for (var i = 0; i < input.Capacity; i++) { } Remarks With players it pairs, the count it was created with. Otherwise one more than the highest PlayerInput player index present, and at least 1 when it was given an action asset. IsDisposed Whether Dispose() ran, by a call or because the application quit. public bool IsDisposed { get; } Property Value bool Examples if (input.IsDisposed) return; IsPairingOpen Whether a button press on a device nobody holds pairs it now. public bool IsPairingOpen { get; } Property Value bool Examples var open = input.IsPairingOpen; PlayerCount How many players are present, the host counted once. public int PlayerCount { get; } Property Value int Examples var players = input.PlayerCount; Remarks With players this LocalInput pairs, how many are paired. Otherwise the number of PlayerInput components present, or 1 when it was given an action asset and no PlayerInput exists. Methods ClosePairing() Stops pairing new players. A player whose device is lost still takes the next device pressed. public PairingResult ClosePairing() Returns PairingResult Applied, or why this LocalInput pairs nothing. Examples input.ClosePairing(); Dispose() Releases every player's action copy and InputUser, ends every rebind capture, stops recording and stops listening for button presses. Every handle then reads its resting value. Calling it again does nothing. public void Dispose() Examples private void OnDestroy() => m_Input.Dispose(); Remarks The application quitting, which in the Editor is the end of Play Mode, calls it for every LocalInput still alive. OpenPairing() Starts pairing: from now on a button press on a device nobody holds pairs it with the host while nobody holds the host, and with the lowest free guest index after that. public PairingResult OpenPairing() Returns PairingResult Applied, or why this LocalInput pairs nothing. Examples input.OpenPairing(); Remarks The first open ends the solo start: the host keeps their InputUser and Identity, their devices are unpaired so their actions read none, and the next device pressed becomes the host's. Player(int) One player of this machine, by index from 0. The host of the setup that pairs players is player 0. public InputPlayer Player(int index) Parameters Type Name Description int index Which player, from 0. Returns InputPlayer The player. Examples var jump = input.Player(1).Button("Jump"); Remarks The returned value is a view that allocates nothing, so reading it every frame is free. An index beyond what the setup holds is a player nobody holds. Exceptions LunyInputException index is negative.

reference/CodeSmile.LunyInput.PlayerActi.title: Class PlayerAction | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunyInput.PlayerActi.summary: Class PlayerAction Namespace CodeSmile.LunyInput Assembly ApiSource.dll One player's action, found by name in the action asset: whether it is pressed, the phases it received in the frame that is running, the control it is bound to, and its rebinding. ButtonAction, NumberAction, Vector2Action and Vector3Action add the value. public abstract class PlayerAction Expand Details ... Inheritance object PlayerAction Derived ButtonAction NumberAction Vector2Action Vector3Action Examples if (m_Jump.PerformedThisFrame) m_Body.AddForce(Vector3.up * 5f, ForceMode.Impulse); Remarks Every read allocates nothing and asks no device. It returns what the action last received, recorded while the Input System processed input, so FixedUpdate and Update read the same. The three phases are the action's own, as its interactions report them: a button starts and performs on the press and cancels on the release, a Hold interaction starts on the press and performs when the hold time is reached, a stick starts when it leaves rest and performs on every change, and a pass-through action only performs. PerformedThisFrame is true during the whole frame in which the Input System processed the phase, in FixedUpdate, Update and LateUpdate, whether input is processed before each frame or before each fixed step, and false in every later frame. A press and a release in one frame make all three true in that frame. After the LocalInput is disposed, or after the action's asset was destroyed, every read returns the resting value and no phase. Properties BoundPath The control path the action uses now, such as <Keyboard>/space: its first binding that is not part of a composite, with the override a rebind applied. Null when every binding is a composite; read a composite's paths through Part(string). Allocates nothing. public string BoundPath { get; } Property Value string Examples m_Label.text = m_Fire.BoundPath; CanceledThisFrame Whether the action was canceled during the frame that is running: the release of a button, or a stick returning to rest. public bool CanceledThisFrame { get; } Property Value bool Examples if (m_Charge.CanceledThisFrame) Release(); IsPressed Whether the action's control was held past its press point when the action last received input. public bool IsPressed { get; } Property Value bool Examples if (m_Fire.IsPressed) m_Charge += Time.deltaTime; Kind What this handle reads the action as. public abstract ActionKind Kind { get; } Property Value ActionKind Examples var kind = m_Fire.Kind; Name The action's name as the asset spells it. public string Name { get; } Property Value string Examples Debug.Log(m_Fire.Name); PerformedThisFrame Whether the action performed during the frame that is running: once per press for a button. public bool PerformedThisFrame { get; } Property Value bool Examples if (m_Jump.PerformedThisFrame) Jump(); Player Which player's action this is, from 0. public int Player { get; } Property Value int Examples var player = m_Fire.Player; StartedThisFrame Whether the action started during the frame that is running. public bool StartedThisFrame { get; } Property Value bool Examples if (m_Charge.StartedThisFrame) BeginCharging(); Methods Part(string) One part of the action's composite binding, by the part's name in the action asset, such as up of a 2D vector. public BindingPart Part(string partName) Parameters Type Name Description string partName The part's name, compared case-sensitively; Unity's action editor names the parts of a 2D vector up, down, left and right. Returns BindingPart The part; the same part every time. Examples var up = m_Move.Part("up"); Exceptions LunyInputException The action has no composite part of that name. Rebind() Starts listening for the control that becomes this action's binding. The next control the player presses replaces every binding of the action; Escape cancels. public RebindCapture Rebind() Returns RebindCapture The capture, which is Listening when it started. Examples m_Capture = m_Fire.Rebind(); Remarks The action reads nothing while the capture listens, and the capture ends by itself; read its Status. A composite action, such as a 2D vector of four keys, is rebound one part at a time through Part(string), and its own capture ends at once as Composite. One player rebinds one control at a time. ResetBinding() Removes every override of the action, its composite parts included, so the asset's paths return. public void ResetBinding() Examples m_Fire.ResetBinding(); ToString() The action for a diagnostic. public override string ToString() Returns string For example: "Button Fire of player 0". TryFindPart(string, out BindingPart) Finds one part of the action's composite binding without throwing. public bool TryFindPart(string partName, out BindingPart part) Parameters Type Name Description string partName The part's name, compared case-sensitively. reference/CodeSmile.LunyInput.RebindCapt.summary: Class RebindCapture Namespace CodeSmile.LunyInput Assembly ApiSource.dll One interactive rebind: the Input System listening for the control a player presses next, which then becomes the binding of an action or of one composite part. Rebind() and Rebind() start one. public sealed class RebindCapture Expand Details ... Inheritance object RebindCapture Examples m_Capture = m_Fire.Rebind(); // in a later Update: if (m_Capture.Status == RebindStatus.Succeeded) m_Label.text = m_Fire.BoundPath; Remarks Status is Listening until the capture ends by itself, and then names how it ended. The capture gives its action back at the start of the next input update, before that update processes any event, so the action reads everything from then on and the press that completed the rebind is not delivered to the action it rebound. Nothing needs to be released: a capture that ended holds nothing, and Cancel() ends a capture that is still listening and gives its action back at once. Properties Status Where the capture is: Listening, or how it ended. public RebindStatus Status { get; } Property Value RebindStatus Examples if (m_Capture.Status != RebindStatus.Listening) m_Capture = null; Methods Cancel() Stops a capture that is listening, without changing the binding, and gives the action back; its status becomes Canceled. A capture that already ended keeps its status. public void Cancel() Examples private void OnDisable() => m_Capture?.Cancel();

reference/CodeSmile.LunyInput.RebindStat.title: Enum RebindStatus | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunyInput.RebindStat.summary: Enum RebindStatus Namespace CodeSmile.LunyInput Assembly ApiSource.dll Where one RebindCapture is. Listening is the one state that changes later; every other state is final. public enum RebindStatus Expand Details ... Fields Busy = 5 Another capture for the same player is listening; one player rebinds one control at a time. No capture started. Canceled = 2 The capture ended without a change: Escape was pressed, Cancel() was called, or the LocalInput was disposed. Composite = 4 The action's bindings are a composite, such as a 2D vector of four keys, which is rebound one part at a time through Part(string). No capture started. Denied = 3 The pressed control is already used by another action of the same asset, or by another part of the same composite, so the binding was left unchanged. Failed = 6 The Input System could not start a capture, or the action's asset was destroyed. No capture started. Listening = 0 Waiting for the player to press a control. Succeeded = 1 A control was pressed and the binding now uses it. Examples if (capture.Status == RebindStatus.Succeeded) { }

reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.DeleteOpera.summary: Class DeleteOperation Namespace CodeSmile.LunySave Assembly ApiSource.dll One Delete(string): whether it is done, and how it ended. public sealed class DeleteOperation Expand Details ... Inheritance object DeleteOperation Examples var deleting = m_Saves.Delete("savegames/001.sav"); if (deleting.Succeeded == false) Debug.LogWarning($"Deleting failed as {deleting.Failure}: {deleting.Problem}"); Remarks The file storage completes a delete inside the call that starts it, so IsDone is already true when Delete(string) returns. A delete succeeded when nothing is stored at its path afterwards: the document and the copy an interrupted save left beside it are gone, and a path where nothing was stored counts as well, so a second delete of the same path succeeds too. A delete the file system refused reports Unknown with the system's message, and the document may still be there. Properties Failure Why the delete failed; None after success. A file system that refuses the delete reports Unknown. public SaveFailure Failure { get; } Property Value SaveFailure Examples if (deleting.Failure == SaveFailure.Unknown) ShowDiskWarning(); IsDone True once the delete has ended, successfully or not. public bool IsDone { get; } Property Value bool Examples if (deleting.IsDone) m_Deleting = null; Path The path the delete was given, relative to the player's data folder. public string Path { get; } Property Value string Examples Debug.Log($"deleted {deleting.Path}"); Problem What went wrong, in the file system's own words, or null. public string Problem { get; } Property Value string Examples Debug.LogWarning(deleting.Problem); Succeeded True when nothing is stored at the path any more. public bool Succeeded { get; } Property Value bool Examples m_Status.text = deleting.Succeeded ? "Slot cleared" : "Slot not cleared"; Methods ToString() "deleted savegames/001.sav", or the failure and its problem, for a log line. public override string ToString() Returns string The outcome. Examples Debug.Log(deleting.ToString());

reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.LoadOperati.title: Class LoadOperation | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.LoadOperati.summary: Class LoadOperation Namespace CodeSmile.LunySave Assembly ApiSource.dll One Load(string, SaveSchema) or LoadStreamingAsset(string, SaveSchema): whether it is done, how it ended, the document it read, and which declared fields the stored copy could not give. public sealed class LoadOperation Expand Details ... Inheritance object LoadOperation Examples var loading = m_Saves.Load("savegames/001.sav", Progress); if (loading.IsDone && loading.Succeeded && loading.Document.TryGetNumber("BestScore", out var best)) m_BestScore = best; Remarks A load from the player's data folder, and from StreamingAssets on a platform where that folder is a local folder, completes inside the call that starts it. On Android and the web StreamingAssets is read with a web request, and the load completes in a later frame; IsDone turns true when it has, and reading any property finishes it then. Nothing calls back: the code that holds the operation reads it, so an object destroyed before a load completes is never handed its result. A load that fails hands back no document. A load that succeeds hands back a SaveDocument holding every field the stored copy could give; Omitted(string) names the others, which hold no value, so the caller's own values for them stay as they were. A stored copy of an older version is migrated first, and must then give every field, or the load fails as Unsupported. A load never writes the stored file. Properties Document The document the load read, or null until it succeeded. public SaveDocument Document { get; } Property Value SaveDocument Examples loading.Document.TryGetText("PilotName", out var pilot); Failure Why the load failed; None while pending and after success. public SaveFailure Failure { get; } Property Value SaveFailure Examples if (loading.Failure == SaveFailure.NotFound) StartNewGame(); HasOmissions True when the load succeeded and omitted at least one declared field. public bool HasOmissions { get; } Property Value bool Examples if (loading.HasOmissions) Debug.Log("the save lacks some fields"); IsDone True once the load has ended, successfully or not. public bool IsDone { get; } Property Value bool Examples if (m_Loading != null && m_Loading.IsDone) Apply(m_Loading); Path The path the load was given, relative to the folder it reads. public string Path { get; } Property Value string Examples Debug.Log($"loaded {loading.Path}"); Problem What went wrong, or null: the file system's message, what makes the stored copy unreadable, or which version or migration step refused it. public string Problem { get; } Property Value string Examples Debug.LogWarning(loading.Problem); StoredVersion The version the stored copy had before any migration, or 0 until the load succeeded. Lower than the schema's version when the load migrated it. public int StoredVersion { get; } Property Value int Examples if (loading.StoredVersion < Progress.Version) Debug.Log("migrated an older save"); Succeeded True when the load has ended and Document holds what it read. public bool Succeeded { get; } Property Value bool Examples if (loading.Succeeded) Apply(loading.Document); Methods OmissionReason(string) Why the load omitted this field, such as "absent" or "a text of 80 bytes, and PilotName holds 64", or null when the field loaded or the load did not succeed. public string OmissionReason(string name) Parameters Type Name Description string name A field the schema declares. Returns string The reason, or null. Examples Debug.Log(loading.OmissionReason("PilotName")); Exceptions LunySaveException The schema declares no field of this name. Omitted(string) True when the load succeeded and the stored copy could not give this field: absent, or holding a value the field cannot hold. public bool Omitted(string name) Parameters Type Name Description string name A field the schema declares. Returns bool True when the field was omitted. Examples if (loading.Omitted("PilotName")) m_PilotName = "Pilot"; Exceptions LunySaveException The schema declares no field of this name. ToString() "loaded savegames/001.sav", or the failure and its problem, for a log line; "loading" and the path while pending. public override string ToString() Returns string The outcome. Examples Debug.Log(loading.ToString());

reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.LocalSave.h.title: Class LocalSave | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.LocalSave.h.summary: Class LocalSave Namespace CodeSmile.LunySave Assembly ApiSource.dll Saves and loads typed documents on this device, for plain C#: Save(string, SaveDocument), Load(string, SaveSchema), Exists(string) and Delete(string) in the player's writable data folder, LoadStreamingAsset(string, SaveSchema) from the read-only StreamingAssets folder the build ships. Every path is relative to the folder its call uses. public sealed class LocalSave Expand Details ... Inheritance object LocalSave Examples private readonly LocalSave m_Saves = new LocalSave(); private void SaveProgress() { var document = new SaveDocument(Progress); document.SetNumber("BestScore", m_BestScore); m_Saves.Save("savegames/001.sav", document); } Remarks Two folders, both chosen by the platform. The writable folder is Application.persistentDataPath, the one place Unity guarantees a player may write on every platform, and the read-only folder is Application.streamingAssetsPath, which holds the build's copy of Assets/StreamingAssets. Save("savegames/001.sav", document) writes <persistentDataPath>/savegames/001.sav. There is no call that writes to StreamingAssets, takes an absolute path, or reads a file's bytes: CodeSmile.LunySave.SavePath refuses a path that is absolute or leaves its folder, and every read returns a document of a SaveSchema. What a save guarantees. A save writes the whole document to a copy beside the file, flushes it, and replaces the file in one rename, so a failure leaves the previous copy as it was. A load reads the file, runs the schema's migration steps on a copy of an older version, and checks every declared field before it hands back a document; it never writes the file. Exists(string) answers whether a load would find a file, without reading it, and Delete(string) removes the file and the copy an interrupted save left, and succeeds when nothing was stored there. A save, a load, an exists and a delete in the data folder complete inside the call. Reads Application.persistentDataPath and Application.streamingAssetsPath at its first call, so that call is on the main thread, in Awake or later. LunyScript's Progress and Settings documents are stored through the same writer, codec and migration rules, under <persistentDataPath>/LunyScript. Constructors LocalSave() Creates a save store over the platform's two folders. Nothing is read or created until the first call. public LocalSave() Examples private readonly LocalSave m_Saves = new LocalSave(); Methods Delete(string) Removes the document stored at path in the player's data folder, and the copy an interrupted save left beside it, so nothing is stored there afterwards. public DeleteOperation Delete(string path) Parameters Type Name Description string path A relative path such as "savegames/001.sav". Returns DeleteOperation The delete; it has ended when this returns. It succeeded when nothing is stored at the path afterwards, which includes a path where nothing was stored before, so deleting twice succeeds twice. A file system that refuses reports Unknown with the system's message, and the document may still be there. Examples var deleting = m_Saves.Delete("savegames/001.sav"); Exceptions LunySaveException The path is refused. Exists(string) Whether a document is stored at path in the player's data folder, without reading it. public bool Exists(string path) Parameters Type Name Description string path A relative path such as "savegames/001.sav", compared case sensitively like every path. Returns bool True when Load(string, SaveSchema) would find a file there. The file is not read, so a file that is not a readable document counts too; Load(string, SaveSchema) reports that as Unreadable. Examples m_ContinueButton.SetEnabled(m_Saves.Exists("savegames/001.sav")); Exceptions LunySaveException The path is refused. Load(string, SaveSchema) Reads the document stored at path in the player's data folder. public LoadOperation Load(string path, SaveSchema schema) Parameters Type Name Description string path A relative path such as "savegames/001.sav". SaveSchema schema What the document holds; an older stored version is migrated to it. Returns LoadOperation The load; it has ended when this returns. NotFound when nothing is stored there. Examples var loading = m_Saves.Load("savegames/001.sav", Progress); Exceptions LunySaveException The path is refused, or the schema is null, declares no field or leaves a gap in its steps. LoadStreamingAsset(string, SaveSchema) Reads a document the build ships at path in StreamingAssets, such as default settings or a level's starting state. Names are compared case sensitively on every platform. public LoadOperation LoadStreamingAsset(string path, SaveSchema schema) Parameters Type Name Description string path A relative path such as "defaults/progress.json", for the file Assets/StreamingAssets/defaults/progress.json. SaveSchema schema What the document holds; an older stored version is migrated to it. Returns LoadOperation The load. It has ended when this returns where StreamingAssets is a local folder, and in a later frame on Android and the web. Examples var defaults = m_Saves.LoadStreamingAsset("defaults/progress.json", Progress); Exceptions LunySaveException The path is refused, or the schema is null, declares no field or leaves a gap in its steps. Save(string, SaveDocument) Stores document at path in the player's data folder, replacing what is stored there. public SaveOperation Save(string path, SaveDocument document) Parameters Type Name Description string path A relative path such as "savegames/001.sav"; LunySaveException names what a refused path breaks. SaveDocument document The document. Every field its schema declares holds a value. Returns SaveOperation The save; it has ended when this returns. Examples var saving = m_Saves.Save("savegames/001.sav", document); Exceptions LunySaveException The path is refused, the document is null, or a declared field holds no value.

reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.SaveDocumen.title: Class SaveDocument | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.SaveDocumen.summary: Class SaveDocument Namespace CodeSmile.LunySave Assembly ApiSource.dll The values of one document of a SaveSchema: what Save(string, SaveDocument) writes and what a successful LoadOperation returns. Each declared field either holds a value or holds none. public sealed class SaveDocument Expand Details ... Inheritance object SaveDocument Examples var document = new SaveDocument(Progress); document.SetNumber("BestScore", m_BestScore); document.SetText("PilotName", m_PilotName); document.SetVector3("Position", transform.position); var saving = m_Saves.Save("savegames/001.sav", document); Remarks A new document holds no value. A save refuses a document that does not hold every declared field, naming the ones it lacks, because a stored copy without them would make the next load report them as omitted. A loaded document holds every field the stored copy could give it; a field the load omitted holds none, so TryGet returns false for it and the caller's value stays what it was. Each set and read checks that the schema declares the name with that kind, and throws a LunySaveException otherwise, so a misspelt name fails where it is written. Constructors SaveDocument(SaveSchema) Creates a document of schema that holds no value. public SaveDocument(SaveSchema schema) Parameters Type Name Description SaveSchema schema What the document holds. Examples var document = new SaveDocument(Progress); Exceptions LunySaveException The schema is null, declares no field, or its steps leave a gap. Properties Schema The schema this document follows; a save writes its version. public SaveSchema Schema { get; } Property Value SaveSchema Examples Debug.Log($"version {document.Schema.Version}"); Methods Holds(string) Whether the field holds a value. public bool Holds(string name) Parameters Type Name Description string name A field the schema declares. Returns bool True when the field holds a value. Examples if (document.Holds("PilotName") == false) document.SetText("PilotName", "Pilot"); Exceptions LunySaveException The schema declares no field of this name. SetFlag(string, bool) Sets a Flag field. public void SetFlag(string name, bool value) Parameters Type Name Description string name A Flag field of the schema. bool value The value. Examples document.SetFlag("Unlocked", true); Exceptions LunySaveException The schema declares no Flag field of this name. SetNumber(string, double) Sets a Number field. public void SetNumber(string name, double value) Parameters Type Name Description string name A Number field of the schema. double value The value; NaN and the infinities store and load back. Examples document.SetNumber("BestScore", 1200); Exceptions LunySaveException The schema declares no Number field of this name. SetQuaternion(string, Quaternion) Sets a Quaternion field. public void SetQuaternion(string name, Quaternion value) Parameters Type Name Description string name A Quaternion field of the schema. Quaternion value The value, stored with its four components as given. Examples document.SetQuaternion("Facing", transform.rotation); Exceptions LunySaveException The schema declares no Quaternion field of this name. SetText(string, string) Sets a Text field. public void SetText(string name, string value) Parameters Type Name Description string name A Text field of the schema. string value The text; at most the field's byte bound when it has one. Examples document.SetText("PilotName", "Ada"); Exceptions LunySaveException The schema declares no Text field of this name, the text is null, or it is longer than the field's bound. SetTextMap(string, IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string, string>>) Sets a TextMap field. public void SetTextMap(string name, IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string, string>> entries) Parameters Type Name Description string name A TextMap field of the schema. Examples document.SetTextMap("Bindings", new[] { new KeyValuePair<String, String>("Fire", "<Keyboard>/f") }); Exceptions LunySaveException The schema declares no TextMap field of this name, the entries are null, a key or value is null, or a key is given twice. SetVector2(string, Vector2) Sets a Vector2 field. public void SetVector2(string name, Vector2 value) Parameters Type Name Description string name A Vector2 field of the schema. Vector2 value The value. Examples document.SetVector2("Cursor", new Vector2(0.5f, 0.5f)); Exceptions LunySaveException The schema declares no Vector2 field of this name. SetVector3(string, Vector3) Sets a Vector3 field. public void SetVector3(string name, Vector3 value) Parameters Type Name Description string name A Vector3 field of the schema. Vector3 value The value. Examples document.SetVector3("Position", transform.position); Exceptions LunySaveException The schema declares no Vector3 field of this name. TryGetFlag(string, out bool) Reads a Flag field. public bool TryGetFlag(string name, out bool value) Parameters Type Name Description string name A Flag field of the schema. bool value The value, or false when the call returns false. Returns bool False when the field holds no value. Examples if (document.TryGetFlag("Unlocked", out var unlocked)) m_Unlocked = unlocked; Exceptions LunySaveException The schema declares no Flag field of this name. TryGetNumber(string, out double) Reads a Number field. public bool TryGetNumber(string name, out double value) Parameters Type Name Description string name A Number field of the schema. double value The value, or 0 when the call returns false. Returns bool False when the field holds no value. reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.SaveFailure.title: Enum SaveFailure | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.SaveFailure.summary: Enum SaveFailure Namespace CodeSmile.LunySave Assembly ApiSource.dll Why a SaveOperation, LoadOperation or DeleteOperation failed. None while the operation is pending and after it succeeded. public enum SaveFailure : byte Expand Details ... Fields None = 0 Pending, or succeeded. NotFound = 1 No document is stored at the path: the first load of a new game. Unknown = 4 The file system failed in a way LunySave cannot classify, such as a full disk, a file another program holds open or a folder in a document's place. Problem, Problem and Problem carry the system's own message. Unreadable = 2 The stored bytes are not a readable document: not UTF-8, not JSON, or not in the document layout. Unsupported = 3 The stored version is newer than the schema's, no migration step starts from the stored version, a step rejected the document or threw, or the migrated document lacks a declared field. Examples if (loading.Failure == SaveFailure.NotFound) StartNewGame();

reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.SaveFields..title: Class SaveFields | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.SaveFields..summary: Class SaveFields Namespace CodeSmile.LunySave Assembly ApiSource.dll The stored fields of one document while a SaveMigration step converts them. Reads and writes a copy: nothing here reaches the stored file or a document a caller holds. public sealed class SaveFields Expand Details ... Inheritance object SaveFields Examples fields.Rename("best", "BestScore"); fields.DefaultNumber("Coins", 0); if (fields.TryGetNumber("seconds", out var seconds)) fields.SetNumber("Minutes", seconds / 60.0); Remarks A field is read by the kind the reader asks for, because the file stores values, not kinds: a number reads with TryGetNumber(string, out double), true or false with TryGetFlag(string, out bool), a text with TryGetText(string, out string), an array of two, three or four numbers with TryGetVector2(string, out Vector2), TryGetVector3(string, out Vector3) or TryGetQuaternion(string, out Quaternion), and an object of texts with TryGetTextMap(string, out KeyValuePair<string, string>[]). Names are case sensitive. A name written by a step uses letters, digits, dash and underscore, 1 to 64 of them, the rule SaveSchema applies; any other name throws, and the load fails as Unsupported. reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.SaveMigrati.title: Class SaveMigration | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.SaveMigrati.summary: Class SaveMigration Namespace CodeSmile.LunySave Assembly ApiSource.dll One consecutive step of a document's schema: converts a stored document of FromVersion into version FromVersion + 1. Registered with Migration(SaveMigration). public abstract class SaveMigration Expand Details ... Inheritance object SaveMigration Examples public sealed class ProgressVersion1To2 : SaveMigration { public override Int32 FromVersion => 1; public override SaveMigrationResult Migrate(SaveFields fields) { fields.Rename("best", "BestScore"); fields.DefaultText("PilotName", "Pilot"); return SaveMigrationResult.Converted; } } Remarks A load of a document stored at an older version runs every step from that version to the schema's, in order, on a copy of the stored fields. Migrate(SaveFields) sees only that copy, through SaveFields. A step that returns Rejected(string) or throws fails the load as Unsupported, and the stored file is not changed. A migrated document must hold every field the schema declares. Migration never writes the upgraded document back; the next save does. A schema is usually kept in a static readonly field and serves every load, so a step keeps no state of its own between calls. Properties FromVersion The stored version this step converts. It produces FromVersion + 1. public abstract int FromVersion { get; } Property Value int Examples public override Int32 FromVersion => 1; Methods Migrate(SaveFields) Converts the fields of a version FromVersion document in place into the fields of the next version. public abstract SaveMigrationResult Migrate(SaveFields fields) Parameters Type Name Description SaveFields fields A copy of the stored fields, as the previous step left them. Returns SaveMigrationResult Converted, or Rejected(string) with the reason when this document cannot be converted. Examples public override SaveMigrationResult Migrate(SaveFields fields) { if (fields.TryGetNumber("seconds", out var seconds) == false) return SaveMigrationResult.Rejected("the save has no play time"); fields.SetNumber("Minutes", seconds / 60.0); fields.Remove("seconds"); return SaveMigrationResult.Converted; } ToString() The step's type and versions, for a diagnostic. public override string ToString() Returns string For example: "ProgressVersion1To2 (version 1 to 2)". Examples Debug.Log(new ProgressVersion1To2().ToString());

Inheritance object SaveOperation Examples var saving = m_Saves.Save("savegames/001.sav", document); if (saving.IsDone && saving.Succeeded == false) Debug.LogWarning($"Saving failed as {saving.Failure}: {saving.Problem}"); Remarks The file storage completes a save inside the call that starts it, so IsDone is already true when Save(string, SaveDocument) returns. reference/CodeSmile.LunySave.SaveSchema..summary: Class SaveSchema Namespace CodeSmile.LunySave Assembly ApiSource.dll What one kind of document holds: its version, its fields by name and kind, and the migration steps that convert an older stored version. Each method returns a new schema and leaves this one as it was, so a schema kept in a static readonly field never changes after it is built. public sealed class SaveSchema Expand Details ... Inheritance object SaveSchema Examples // A Unity type holding a static field carries [NoAutoStaticsCleanup]: the schema never changes, so nothing resets it. [NoAutoStaticsCleanup] public sealed class Saves : MonoBehaviour { static readonly SaveSchema Progress = new SaveSchema(2) .Number("BestScore").Text("PilotName", 64).Vector3("Position") .Migration(new ProgressVersion1To2()); } Remarks A field name is 1 to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, case sensitive, and is the key stored in the file, so keep it when the C# that fills it is renamed. Each method checks what it can at once and throws a LunySaveException: a name given twice, a step from a version the schema cannot have, two steps from one version. A schema with no field, or whose steps leave a version without a step between the oldest one and the current one, is refused where it is first used, because a later call may still add the field or step. Constructors SaveSchema(int) Creates a schema of version with no field and no step. public SaveSchema(int version = 1) Parameters Type Name Description int version The schema version a save writes, 1 or more. Raise it when the fields change, and register a SaveMigration from the previous version. Examples var settings = new SaveSchema().Number("MusicVolume"); Exceptions LunySaveException The version is below 1. Properties FieldCount How many fields the schema declares. public int FieldCount { get; } Property Value int Examples Debug.Log($"{Progress.FieldCount} fields"); Version The schema version a save writes and a load converts to. public int Version { get; } Property Value int Examples Debug.Log($"progress schema version {Progress.Version}"); Methods Declares(string) Whether the schema declares a field of this name. public bool Declares(string name) Parameters Type Name Description string name The field name, compared case sensitively. Returns bool True when the schema declares it. Returns SaveSchema A new schema with the field added. Examples var schema = new SaveSchema().Flag("Unlocked"); Exceptions LunySaveException The name is not storable or already declared. Migration(SaveMigration) Registers the step that converts a stored document of FromVersion to the next version. public SaveSchema Migration(SaveMigration step) Parameters Type Name Description SaveMigration step The step. It keeps no state between calls. Returns SaveSchema A new schema with the step added. Examples var schema = new SaveSchema(2).Number("BestScore").Migration(new ProgressVersion1To2()); Exceptions LunySaveException The step is null, starts from a version outside 1 to Version minus 1, or starts from a version another step starts from. Number(string) Declares a field holding a Double, which every value of stores and loads back exactly, including NaN and the infinities. public SaveSchema Number(string name) Parameters Type Name Description string name The field name. Returns SaveSchema A new schema with the field added. Examples var schema = new SaveSchema().Number("BestScore"); Exceptions LunySaveException The name is not storable or already declared. Returns SaveSchema A new schema with the field added. Examples var schema = new SaveSchema().Quaternion("Facing"); Exceptions LunySaveException The name is not storable or already declared. reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.ActionBlo.summary: Class ActionBlock Namespace CodeSmile.LunyScript Assembly ApiSource.dll A block whose objective can take more than one frame, and which therefore reports ActionResult rather than simply running to completion. public abstract class ActionBlock : Block, IScriptNode Expand Details ... Inheritance object Block ActionBlock Implements IScriptNode Inherited Members Block.Contexts Block.RequiredServices Block.DescribeChildren(NodeDescription) Block.Location Block.ExecuteAll(Block[], ScriptInstance) Block.AdvanceContained(ActionBlock, ScriptInstance) Block.None Examples internal sealed class CountDownBlock : ActionBlock { private readonly NumberSlot m_Remaining; public override void Begin(ScriptInstance instance) => instance.SetNumber(m_Remaining, 3.0); public override ActionResult Advance(ScriptInstance instance) { instance.SetNumber(m_Remaining, instance.GetNumber(m_Remaining) - 1.0); return instance.GetNumber(m_Remaining) > 0.0 ? ActionResult.Running : ActionResult.Succeeded; } } Remarks An ordinary Block does its work inside one Execute(ScriptInstance) call. An action is advanced once per frame by whatever owns it - a routine activation, or a concurrent group - until it reports Succeeded or Failed. The per-object state of an action lives in slots, not in fields. One action object is shared by every object running the script, exactly as every other block is, so AGENTS.md rule 22 applies unchanged: declare the slots the action needs during Build() and read and write them through the ScriptInstance each call is given. The owner calls Begin(ScriptInstance) once when the activation reaches this action, then Advance(ScriptInstance) once per frame while it reports Running, and Cancel(ScriptInstance) instead of any further advance when the activation is interrupted. Constructors ActionBlock(SourceLocation) Creates an action that knows where it was authored. protected ActionBlock(SourceLocation location = default) Parameters Type Name Description SourceLocation location Where the factory that built it was called, or Unknown. Methods Advance(ScriptInstance) Advances this action by one frame and reports what it has reached. public abstract ActionResult Advance(ScriptInstance instance) Parameters Type Name Description ScriptInstance instance The object's state and host. Returns ActionResult Running while the objective is still pending, otherwise the finished outcome. Examples public override ActionResult Advance(ScriptInstance instance) => ActionResult.Succeeded; Begin(ScriptInstance) Puts this action's slots into their starting state for one activation. Called once, by the owner, before the first Advance(ScriptInstance) of that activation. public virtual void Begin(ScriptInstance instance) Parameters Type Name Description ScriptInstance instance The object's state and host. Examples public override void Begin(ScriptInstance instance) => instance.SetNumber(m_ElapsedSlot, 0.0); Cancel(ScriptInstance) Interrupts this action and performs its own bounded cleanup. An action that is cancelled reports no outcome at all: cancellation is neither Succeeded nor Failed. public virtual void Cancel(ScriptInstance instance) Parameters Type Name Description ScriptInstance instance The object's state and host. Examples public override void Cancel(ScriptInstance instance) => instance.SetFlag(m_ChasingSlot, false); Execute(ScriptInstance) Advances this action once when it is used where an ordinary block is expected, and discards the result because nothing at that position waits for one. public override void Execute(ScriptInstance instance) Parameters Type Name Description ScriptInstance instance The object's state and host. Examples On.Update(action); // one advance per frame, nothing waits for the result

reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.ActionRes.title: Enum ActionResult | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.ActionRes.summary: Enum ActionResult Namespace CodeSmile.LunyScript Assembly ApiSource.dll What an action reports about the objective it was given: still pending, finished having met it, or finished having failed to meet it. public enum ActionResult Expand Details ... Fields Failed = 2 The action finished without meeting its objective. Running = 0 The objective is still pending; the owner advances this action again next frame. Succeeded = 1 The action finished and met its objective. Examples public override ActionResult Advance(ScriptInstance instance) => instance.GetNumber(m_RemainingSlot) > 0.0 ? ActionResult.Running : ActionResult.Succeeded; Remarks These are the three outcome words docs/execution-model.md accepts: Succeeded and Failed are the two natural finished outcomes and Running describes an objective still pending. An action reports Failed only through its own specified domain-failure behaviour; a C# exception thrown out of an action is not a Failed result, it is a contained action failure that stops the instance, and docs/execution-model.md, "Contained action failures", owns that path. Cancellation is not a member of this enum, deliberately. Cancellation interrupts work and is neither Succeeded nor Failed, so it is expressed by Cancel(ScriptInstance) rather than by a fourth result. How an interruption is represented to a script is open point G2 in docs/execution-model.md.

reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.AdapterAd.title: Class AdapterAdmission | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.AdapterAd.summary: Class AdapterAdmission Namespace CodeSmile.LunyScript Assembly ApiSource.dll The package and version admission table for extension blocks and optional adapters. public static class AdapterAdmission Expand Details ... Inheritance object AdapterAdmission Examples AdapterAdmission.Register(typeof(PuppetMasterDoSomethingBlock), "com.example.puppetmaster", "1.2.0", "PuppetMaster.LunyScript"); AdapterAdmission.NoteInstalled("com.example.puppetmaster", "1.4.0"); Remarks This is not a listing of the public API. The implementation queue called it a registration catalog. An adapter calls Register(Type, string, string, string, string, int) once per block type it adds, naming the Unity package and the minimum version that type needs. An author never writes a catalog line in Build(). Admission is checked at spawn, in the same ValidateCapabilities pass that already refuses a host that cannot provide the program's services. A missing package or a version older than the registered minimum raises LunyScriptUsageException and the instance is not created, so no registered block runs and no null-reference path is reached. The check is not on the per-frame path. The registered version is a minimum. An installed package newer than the declared version is admitted, including a later major such as Unity 7's 6.7.0 against a 1.8.0 minimum. That is the same rule Unity's versionDefines expression uses. reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetPlac.title: Class AssetPlaceholders | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetPlac.summary: Class AssetPlaceholders Namespace CodeSmile.LunyScript Assembly ApiSource.dll The asset placeholder every asset type falls back to when an input of that type is left unassigned, and the two ways one is configured. public static class AssetPlaceholders Expand Details ... Inheritance object AssetPlaceholders Examples AssetPlaceholders.Register<Texture2D>(myPlaceholderTexture); Remarks An unassigned binding must not enter execution as a null reference. That is the settled requirement; the placeholder is chosen to be recognisable and to change no gameplay outcome, and using one is always reported so that a placeholder never hides the missing assignment. Where no placeholder can be both recognisable and harmless, the type gets none and the binding fails instead. This is not Unity's Preset feature. A Unity Preset stores Inspector settings and applies them to filtered assets; an asset placeholder is the object a declared [Asset] input resolves to when no assigned asset is available. A placeholder is built the first time a type actually needs one, and then kept. A scene in which every input is assigned builds none of them, which is why the built-in registrations are factories rather than objects. This is mutable static state, and it carries the attribute that resets it. AGENTS.md rule 17 forbids one and rule 18 names [AutoStaticsCleanup] as the mechanism for the unavoidable case: with domain reload disabled a static keeps its value from the previous Play session, and a placeholder built in that session is a destroyed object by the time the next one reads it. The type is partial because Unity's code generator emits a second partial declaration holding the generated reset method. A registration a package makes in code is re-applied after that reset the way it was applied the first time, from a startup callback. The project settings asset the accepted design names as the second configuration source is not implemented yet; AssetPlaceholderSource is where it joins, and every diagnostic already names the source it came from. Called at most once per declared type. Type Parameters T The asset type the placeholder applies to. Examples AssetPlaceholders.Register<Mesh>(_ => BuildPlaceholderMesh()); Exceptions LunyScriptUsageException factory is null. Register<T>(T) Registers one object as the asset placeholder for a type, replacing the built-in placeholder. public static void Register<T>(T placeholder) where T : Object Parameters Type Name Description T placeholder The object an unassigned input of that type resolves to. Type Parameters T The asset type the placeholder applies to. Examples AssetPlaceholders.Register<AudioClip>(placeholderBeep); Exceptions LunyScriptUsageException placeholder is null. Removing a placeholder is Clear<T>(), so that a null cannot pass for an intention. ResetToBuiltIn() Drops every registration and every placeholder built so far, so the next caller starts from the built-in set. A test calls this between cases. public static void ResetToBuiltIn() Examples AssetPlaceholders.ResetToBuiltIn(); SourceFor(Type) Whether a type has an asset placeholder at all, without building one. public static AssetPlaceholderSource SourceFor(Type declaredType) Parameters Type Name Description Type declaredType The type an input declared. Returns AssetPlaceholderSource Which configuration names it, or None. Examples var source = AssetPlaceholders.SourceFor(typeof(Texture2D));

reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.AudioMixe.summary: Struct AudioMixer Namespace CodeSmile.LunyScript Assembly ApiSource.dll A handle to one AudioMixer input of a script: an audio mixer the object's Inspector assigns. Returned by Bind.AudioMixer() at build time, or assigned before Build() by [Asset] on the property. public readonly struct AudioMixer Expand Details ... Examples Master = Bind.AudioMixer(); On.Ready(Audio.Mixer(Master).Set("MusicVolume", -12)); Remarks This is LunyScript's type, with Unity's name. A script imports only CodeSmile.LunyScript, so AudioMixer there is this handle and the script compiles without an engine reference. The Inspector field accepts a UnityEngine.Audio.AudioMixer, and C# on the object reads the assigned asset with LunyScriptBehaviour.GetAsset. A file that imports both namespaces writes UnityEngine.Audio.AudioMixer for Unity's type. The declared name is the input's durable identity. A value stored on a host is matched to the input by that name. A generated property gives the input its member's name, and .As(name) names it explicitly. Renaming it orphans what a scene stored for the old name. No asset placeholder exists for a mixer, so an object that assigns none and names no source refuses to spawn. A handle is valid only inside the Build that declared it, for the reason Var<T> states: it carries a slot index and nothing that identifies its program. Properties IsDeclared False for a handle Build() never declared, or one still waiting for its name. public bool IsDeclared { get; } Property Value bool Name The name the script declared, which is what a stored value is matched against and what a diagnostic names. Null until the declaration has its name. public string Name { get; } Property Value string Methods ToString() The declared name and kind, for a log line or a failure message. public override string ToString() Returns string For example: "Master : AudioMixer". Operators implicit operator AudioMixer(AssetInputBuilder<AudioMixer>) Declares the input a Bind.AudioMixer() chain describes. The generated property of the line then gives it the member's name. public static implicit operator AudioMixer(AssetInputBuilder<AudioMixer> declaration) Parameters Type Name Description AssetInputBuilder<AudioMixer> declaration The chain. Returns AudioMixer The handle. Examples Master = Bind.AudioMixer();

The tree's result is the root's result. public BehaviorTree Root(BehaviorNode root) Parameters Type Name Description BehaviorNode root The root: a composite, a wrapper, a Repeat or a leaf. reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.BehaviorC.title: Struct BehaviorCompositeBuilder | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.BehaviorC.summary: Struct BehaviorCompositeBuilder Namespace CodeSmile.LunyScript Assembly ApiSource.dll What InOrder(...), InParallel(...) and InAnyOrder(...) return when their children are behaviour-tree nodes: a composite with no ending clause yet. public readonly struct BehaviorCompositeBuilder Expand Details ... Examples var patrol = InOrder(Task(Goal.Set(PostA)), Task(Wait(1)), Task(Goal.Set(PostB))).UntilOneFails(); Remarks Used as it is, the composite runs every child and reports Succeeded only if every child succeeded, and Failed otherwise; a failure does not stop it early. UntilOneFails() and UntilOneSucceeds() replace that with an early ending. InOrder and InAnyOrder run one child at a time and resume at the child that reported Running; InParallel advances every child once per advance, in the order they are written, and cancels the children still running when it ends early. docs/proposals/behaviour-trees.md is the contract. Methods UntilOneFails() The first child to fail ends this composite Failed. When every child succeeded, the composite ends Succeeded. public BehaviorNode UntilOneFails() Returns BehaviorNode The composite, as a node. Examples var open = InOrder(Check(HasKey), Task(Opening.Set(true))).UntilOneFails(); UntilOneSucceeds() The first child to succeed ends this composite Succeeded. When every child failed, the composite ends Failed. public BehaviorNode UntilOneSucceeds() Returns BehaviorNode The composite, as a node. Examples var getIn = InOrder(Check(DoorOpen), Task(Climb.Set(true))).UntilOneSucceeds(); Operators implicit operator BehaviorNode(BehaviorCompositeBuilder) Finalises this composite with no ending clause: every child runs, and the composite succeeds only if every child succeeded. public static implicit operator BehaviorNode(BehaviorCompositeBuilder builder) Parameters Type Name Description BehaviorCompositeBuilder builder The composite. Returns BehaviorNode Examples var tidy = Behavior("Tidy").Root(InOrder(Task(Cups.Set(0)), Task(Plates.Set(0))));

reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.BehaviorN.title: Struct BehaviorNode | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.BehaviorN.summary: Struct BehaviorNode Namespace CodeSmile.LunyScript Assembly ApiSource.dll One node of a behaviour tree: a leaf made by Task or Check, a composite made by InOrder, InParallel or InAnyOrder, or a wrapper made by Inverted, AlwaysSucceeds, AlwaysFails or Repeat. public readonly struct BehaviorNode Expand Details ... Examples BehaviorNode openDoor = InOrder(Check(HasKey), Task(Opening.Set(true))).UntilOneFails(); var door = Behavior("Door").Root(openDoor); Remarks A node is placed in a tree only: as a child of a composite, as the child of a wrapper, or as the root given to Behavior(name).Root(...). It is not a Block, so a block or a condition becomes a node only through Task or Check, and a node cannot be placed in an event list. A node held in a local or returned by a method can be placed more than once. Each placement after the first is a copy with progress of its own, as docs/execution-model.md, "Reusing a composed block", states for every composed block.

reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.BehaviorR.title: Struct BehaviorRepeatBuilder | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.BehaviorR.summary: Struct BehaviorRepeatBuilder Namespace CodeSmile.LunyScript Assembly ApiSource.dll What Repeat(node) returns: a node that runs its child again after each finish, with no ending yet. public readonly struct BehaviorRepeatBuilder Expand Details ... Examples var watch = Repeat(Check(!IntruderNear)).UntilFails(); Remarks Used as it is, the Repeat runs its child until its owner cancels it and never reports a result of its own. Times(NumberValueBlock, string, int), UntilFails() and UntilSucceeds() give it an ending. Every form starts at most one fresh repetition per frame: a child that finishes in the advance it began in runs again in the next frame. Methods Times(NumberValueBlock, string, int) Runs the child this many times, one repetition per frame at most, and reports Succeeded only if every repetition succeeded, otherwise Failed. A failed repetition does not stop the count. public BehaviorNode Times(NumberValueBlock count, string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) Parameters Type Name Description NumberValueBlock count How many repetitions. It is read when the Repeat starts; a value that is not a finite whole number of 1 or more stops the object with an error naming this call. string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns BehaviorNode The Repeat, as a node. Examples var lookAround = Repeat(InOrder(Task(Look.Set(-1)), Task(Wait(0.3)))).Times(2); Exceptions LunyScriptUsageException The count is null, or this builder was never obtained from a script's own Repeat(node) call. UntilFails() Runs the child until it fails, one repetition per frame at most, and then reports Failed: the result that stopped the repetition. public BehaviorNode UntilFails() Returns BehaviorNode The Repeat, as a node. Examples var watch = Repeat(Check(!IntruderNear)).UntilFails(); UntilSucceeds() Runs the child until it succeeds, one repetition per frame at most, and then reports Succeeded: the result that stopped the repetition. public BehaviorNode UntilSucceeds() Returns BehaviorNode The Repeat, as a node. Examples var arrive = Repeat(Check(Arrived)).UntilSucceeds(); Operators implicit operator BehaviorNode(BehaviorRepeatBuilder) Finalises this Repeat with no ending: it runs its child until its owner cancels it. public static implicit operator BehaviorNode(BehaviorRepeatBuilder builder) Parameters Type Name Description BehaviorRepeatBuilder builder The Repeat. Returns BehaviorNode Examples var guard = Behavior("Guard").Root(Repeat(InOrder(guarded, chase).UntilOneSucceeds()));

reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.BehaviorT.title: Struct BehaviorTree | LunyScript API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.BehaviorT.summary: Struct BehaviorTree Namespace CodeSmile.LunyScript Assembly ApiSource.dll A declared behaviour tree. Start(string, int) starts or restarts one activation, Stop(string, int) interrupts it, and four conditions read what it reached. public readonly struct BehaviorTree Expand Details ... Examples var open = Behavior("Open").Root(InOrder(Check(HasKey), Task(Opening.Set(true))).UntilOneFails()); On.Message(Use, open.Start()); On.Update(If(open.Failed).Then(Locked.Set(true))); Remarks The runner advances an active tree once per frame, after the object's On.Update blocks, state machines, routines, Run work and Choose selectors. The root descends through immediate work in one advance, so a tree of Checks and immediate Tasks finishes in the advance that starts it. When the root finishes, the activation ends and its result is kept until the next Start: a finished tree does not start again by itself. The handle keeps its build directly and holds no CodeSmile.LunyScript.BuilderLease; only an unfinished builder step holds one. A tree is a declared handle: Start() placed in two event lists starts the one tree. Properties Failed A condition that is true once the last activation's root finished Failed, until the next Start. It is false before the first Start, while an activation runs, and after a Stop that interrupted one. public ConditionBlock Failed { get; } Property Value ConditionBlock Examples On.Update(If(open.Failed).Then(Locked.Set(true))); IsActive A condition that is true while an activation of this tree is running: from Start until the root finishes or a Stop interrupts it. public ConditionBlock IsActive { get; } Property Value ConditionBlock Examples On.Update(If(PlayerNear & !greet.IsActive).Then(greet.Start())); Remarks It reads the same state as Running. With one explicit Start per activation, a tree is active exactly while its root's work is pending. Running A condition that is true while the root's work is pending: from Start until the root finishes or a Stop interrupts it. public ConditionBlock Running { get; } Property Value ConditionBlock Examples On.Update(If(guard.Running).Then(Busy.Set(true))); Succeeded A condition that is true once the last activation's root finished Succeeded, until the next Start. It is false before the first Start, while an activation runs, and after a Stop that interrupted one. public ConditionBlock Succeeded { get; } Property Value ConditionBlock Examples On.Update(If(open.Succeeded).Then(Opened.Set(true))); Methods Start(string, int) The block that starts one activation of this tree. An activation that is running is interrupted first, its running nodes each doing their own cleanup, and a kept result is cleared. The tree is first advanced in the frame's tree pass, which follows On.Update. public Block Start(string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) Parameters Type Name Description string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns Block The start block. Examples On.Ready(guard.Start()); Stop(string, int) The block that interrupts an activation of this tree. Its running nodes each do their own cleanup and the tree is left without a result. A tree that finished keeps its result, and one that is not active is left as it is. public Block Stop(string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) Parameters Type Name Description string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns Block The stop block. Examples On.Update(If(Health <= 0).Then(guard.Stop()));

reference/CodeSmile.LunyScript.BindFacto.summary: Struct BindFactory Namespace CodeSmile.LunyScript Assembly ApiSource.dll The Bind surface inside Build(): declares the inputs a script needs - assets, scenes and objects in a scene - and hands back the typed handles that read them. public readonly struct BindFactory Expand Details ... Examples protected override void Build() { OpenSound = Bind.AudioClip(); Sentry = Bind.Prefab().FromResources("Enemies/Sentry"); Witch = Bind.Object(); } Remarks This is a build-time surface. Every call runs once per script type, before any object exists, and constructs part of the shared Script program, which is why it may allocate; AGENTS.md rule 43. What an input holds is per object and is resolved when that object spawns. The declared name is the input's durable identity. A value stored on a host is matched to an input by name, so the name comes from nameof and a rename orphans what a scene stored under the old one. A line without a name gets its member's name. OpenSound = Bind.AudioClip(); in a partial script makes the generator write the OpenSound property, whose setter gives the input the name OpenSound. .As(name) names a declaration explicitly, which a hand-written property or a local needs. [Asset] on a property declares the same input. Every handle is a LunyScript type. Texture2D(string, int), AudioClip(string, int), AudioMixer(string, int), AudioMixerGroup(string, int) and VisualTreeAsset(string, int) carry Unity's names in LunyScript's namespace, so a script that uses them compiles without an engine reference. Methods AudioClip(string, int) Declares an audio clip input the host supplies. An object that assigns nothing gets a short low tone as its asset placeholder. public AssetInputBuilder<AudioClip> AudioClip(string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) Parameters Type Name Description string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns AssetInputBuilder<AudioClip> The declaration; assigning it declares the input. Examples Shot = Bind.AudioClip(); AudioMixer(string, int) Declares an audio mixer input the host supplies, whose exposed parameters Audio.Mixer writes. No asset placeholder exists for a mixer. public AssetInputBuilder<AudioMixer> AudioMixer(string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) Parameters Type Name Description string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns AssetInputBuilder<AudioMixer> The declaration; assigning it declares the input. Examples Master = Bind.AudioMixer(); AudioMixerGroup(string, int) Declares an input for one group of an audio mixer, which a one-shot plays Through. No asset placeholder exists for a mixer group. public AssetInputBuilder<AudioMixerGroup> AudioMixerGroup(string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) Parameters Type Name Description string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns AssetInputBuilder<AudioMixerGroup> The declaration; assigning it declares the input. Examples Effects = Bind.AudioMixerGroup(); Data<TValue, THandle>(DataSchema<TValue, THandle>, string, int) Starts a data input of schema: an Inspector-assigned data asset whose field of that schema each object copies when it spawns, or with FromStreamingAssets, FromUserData or FromTemp a JSON file that Asset.Load(file).Into(data) reads. public DataInputBuilder<TValue, THandle> Data<TValue, THandle>(DataSchema<TValue, THandle> schema, string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) where TValue : struct where THandle : struct, ILunyScriptDataVariables Parameters Type Name Description DataSchema<TValue, THandle> schema The struct's generated Schema. string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns DataInputBuilder<TValue, THandle> The unfinished declaration. Type Parameters TValue The schema struct, inferred from the schema. THandle Its generated Variables, inferred from the schema. Examples Balance = Bind.Data(WeaponStats.Schema); StatsFile = Bind.Data(WeaponStats.Schema).FromStreamingAssets("weapon.json"); Flag(string, string, int) Binds a shared Flag this script did not define. Call Shared to finish; without it this is not a handle. public FlagBindBuilder Flag(string name, string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) Parameters Type Name Description string name The name, which should come from nameof. string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns FlagBindBuilder A builder whose Shared names the store. Examples MatchActive = Bind.Flag(nameof(MatchActive)).Shared(); Exceptions LunyScriptUsageException The name is taken in this script, or this surface was read outside Build(). Number(int, string) Starts a number input that copies a field of an Inspector-assigned data asset; FromDataField(field) names the field. public NumberInputBuilder Number(int callerLineNumber = 0, string callerFilePath = null) Parameters Type Name Description int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Returns NumberInputBuilder The unfinished declaration. Examples Power = Bind.Number().FromDataField("SomeValue"); Remarks The caller information comes first so that Bind.Number(name), the shared-number form, stays the only overload a string argument selects. Number(string, string, int) Binds a shared Number this script did not define. Call Shared to finish; without it this is not a handle. public NumberBindBuilder Number(string name, string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) Parameters Type Name Description string name The name, which should come from nameof. string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns NumberBindBuilder A builder whose Shared names the store. Examples TeamScore = Bind.Number(nameof(TeamScore)).Shared(); Exceptions LunyScriptUsageException The name is taken in this script, or this surface was read outside Build(). Object(string, int) Declares a binding to one object in a scene: the object the host's Inspector assigns, or else the first object in the spawning object's own scene whose name is the declared name. public ObjectBindingBuilder Object(string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) Parameters Type Name Description string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns ObjectBindingBuilder The declaration; assigning it declares the binding. Examples Witch = Bind.Object(); Enemy = Bind.Object().WithTag("Enemy").Named("Guard").LiveRebind(); Door = Bind.Object().MustExist(); Remarks Nothing found is an ordinary state. The binding is unavailable, IsValid is false, a write through it does nothing and no object is created in its place. WithTag and Named replace the name search, MustExist() refuses to start the script when nothing is found, and LiveRebind() searches again while the binding has no object. Prefab(string, int) Declares a prefab input the host supplies. Object.Create and Define.Pool take it. public AssetInputBuilder<Prefab> Prefab(string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) Parameters Type Name Description string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns AssetInputBuilder<Prefab> The declaration; assigning it declares the input. Examples Sentry = Bind.Prefab(); Marker = Bind.Prefab().FromResources("Enemies/Sentry"); Remarks A GameObject the host assigned that is not a prefab asset is refused, with an error naming the input, and the input then resolves as if nothing had been assigned: copying a scene object duplicates that object instead of producing a new one from an asset. Object(string, int) declares a binding to an object in the scene. Scene(string, int) Declares a scene input: the typed scene identity Scene.Load, Scene.Unload and the When.Scene* watches take. The host's Inspector assigns the scene. public SceneInputBuilder Scene(string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) Parameters Type Name Description string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns SceneInputBuilder The declaration; assigning it declares the input. Examples Arena = Bind.Scene(); Remarks There is no source and no placeholder for a scene. Substituting a scene would change what the game is, so an object that assigns none still spawns, the missing assignment is reported once per script type, and a Scene.Load of it fails as OperationFailure.NotFound. Text(string, TextCapacity, string, int) Binds a shared text of the given capacity this script did not define. The capacity has to be the one every other declaration of the name uses. Call Shared to finish. public TextBindBuilder Text(string name, TextCapacity capacity, string callerFilePath = null, int callerLineNumber = 0) Parameters Type Name Description string name The name, which should come from nameof. TextCapacity capacity How many bytes the shared slot holds. string callerFilePath Supplied by the compiler. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns TextBindBuilder A builder whose Shared names the store. Do not pass one. int callerLineNumber Supplied by the compiler. Returns TextBindBuilder A builder whose Shared names the store.
