InputActionResolution Why an input action declaration did or did not resolve to a configured action. InputPairingResult What a backend did with a request to open or close pairing, or to release a local player, and why not when it did nothing. InputPhase The three occurrences one input action reports, which are the three the accepted design names and the three phases of the same names an Input System action reports. InputRebindPoll What polling one in-flight rebind capture reports. Must allocate nothing while pending. InputRebindStart Whether an interactive rebind capture started, and why not when it did not. InputValueKind What one input action produces. The four kinds are the ones the accepted design names: Button, Number, Vector2 and Vector3. LifetimeRequest What an authored Object.Activate(), Object.Deactivate(), Object.Destroy() or Object.Despawn() asked the runner to do to the object a script runs on. LunyScriptLogSeverity How serious one LunyScript log record is. MotionMechanism Which movement component ProbeMotionMechanism() selected. NavigationAgentState Whether an actor can navigate, as a navigation backend reports it. Every value other than Ready is a reason a Navigation.MoveTo attempt fails as OperationFailure.Denied. NavigationRouteState What a navigation backend knows about the route an actor follows. Script code reads it through Navigation.Route(operation). NetworkValueKind Which field of a NetworkValue carries the value. NumberFunction Which function a CodeSmile.LunyScript.NumberFunctionBlock evaluates, and which write a NumberMutateBlock applies to its slot. NumberState Which question a CodeSmile.LunyScript.NumberStateBlock asks about one number. OperationFailure Every failure an operation can produce, classified once by the gateway so that no script and no block ever sees an exception type. See AGENTS.md section 12, rule 51. PlayerContact Whether the objects local players control stop at each other or pass through each other, which Input.Pairing.SetPlayerContact(contact) writes for the machine. Process Whether a script ticks while the runner is paused, and whether it ticks at all. ProcessOverride The Inspector override of Process on one LunyScriptBehaviour. RotationUnary Which orientation a CodeSmile.LunyScript.RotationUnaryBlock makes out of one. RoundingMode How Math.Round and Number.Round resolve a value exactly halfway between two whole numbers. Scope How many instances of a script type run, which a script declares in its Options property with RunAs(scope). ScriptContexts Execution contexts a node or service supports. ScriptServices Services required by composed nodes, independently of their execution contexts. SessionState What a session is doing. Read through Net.IsConnected and reported by State. SlotKind Which kind of slot a variable occupies. A slot kind is one array on ScriptInstance, so adding a kind is adding an array, a layout counter and a branch, and nothing else. SyncKind The three kinds of cadence. A rate cap is a property of OnChange rather than a fourth kind, because a capped and an uncapped OnChange send on the same condition and differ only in how often. TextArgumentKind Which kind of value one TextArgument carries. TextCapacity How many bytes a text variable can hold. Declared per variable at build time, because the five capacities are five distinct Unity.Collections.FixedString types and a text variable is stored in exactly one of them. TextLength Named byte bounds for each Text entry in a list or map. Declared per collection side at build time, because the five sizes are five distinct Unity.Collections.FixedString types and every entry on that side uses exactly one of them. TransformAxis Which component of a transform value a read produces. TransformChannel Which part of an object's transform a declaration synchronises. One channel is one declaration with one cadence, which is AGENTS.md rule 46 applied to the transform: a scale that never changes cannot share a payload with a position that changes every tick. TransformPart Which of the three values of a transform a verb reads or writes. TransformRelation Which object a transform verb acts on, named relative to the object the script runs on. TransformSpace Which frame a transform verb's numbers are in. Vector2Arithmetic Which combination a CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vector2ArithmeticBlock makes of two values. Vector2Component Which component a CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vector2WithComponentBlock replaces. Vector2Scalar Which number a CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vector2ScalarBlock takes out of one or two values. Vector2Unary Which spatial value a CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vector2UnaryBlock makes out of one. Vector3Arithmetic Which combination a CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vector3ArithmeticBlock makes of two spatial values. Vector3Component Which component a CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vector3WithComponentBlock replaces. Vector3Scalar Which number a CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vector3ScalarBlock takes out of one or two spatial values. Vector3Unary Which spatial value a CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vector3UnaryBlock makes out of one. Delegates AssetPlaceholderFactory Builds the asset placeholder for one declared asset type.
